name: farm-status
description: Give a snapshot of overall farm status: crops, livestock, buildings, and weather

arguments.farmId: Optional AgriFarm URN to scope the report; omit for all farms

rollups: count animals by species and by healthCondition
count animals not located in a pasture-type parcel
summarize weather conditions across parcels: temperature, wind, precipitation, pressure trend
template: Give a farm status report for farmId={{farmId}}. Call {{tools}} for each type in {{types}}, picking the fields listed per type in {{pick}}. Compute: {{rollups}}. Summarize herd health, crop status, and weather in a few sentences, calling out anything abnormal.
